title: Evaluation of an App-Based Self-Directed Cognitive Training Program—Effects on Cognitive Function and Quality of Life in Patients with Schizophrenia-Spectrum Disorders
summary:
Cognitive impairments are a common symptom of schizophrenia-spectrum disorders that reduce the quality of life for those affected. Medication does not address cognitive impairments.
The study aims to evaluate an app-based intervention designed to improve cognitive function in individuals with schizophrenia-spectrum disorders, focusing on improvements in cognitive performance and the impact on quality of life.
To this end, objective measurements as well as data from self-reports and interviews will be collected.

interventions.name: Participants in the intervention group will be given access to app-based cognitive training through the “NeuronationMED” app. They will be instructed to complete the digital cognitive training independently three times a week over a 12-week period. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
General Eligibility Criteria:
- The patient is between 18 and 50 years old.
- The patient speaks German fluently.
- The patient is able to use a smartphone with or without visual aids.
- The patient is able to fully understand all information provided verbally and in writing and agrees to participate in the study.
- The patient must provide a legally valid informed consent form.

Schizophrenia Data:
- Diagnosis from the F2 spectrum of the ICD-10: The patient has a clinically confirmed diagnosis of schizophrenia, confirmed by the treating physician and based on the national S3 guidelines.
Exclusion criteria:
Health Risks – Mental Disorders:
- Life-threatening crisis or active suicidal ideation (assessed using the MINI-DIPs).

Health Risks – Neurological Disorders:
- No history of neurological disorders (e.g., epilepsy, stroke, multiple sclerosis, dementia, traumatic brain injury).

Health Risks – Other:
- No history of serious medical conditions (e.g., cancer, autoimmune diseases, chronic inflammatory diseases, cardiovascular diseases).

Medication:
- No current treatment with benzodiazepines (washout period of > 3 half-lives).
